title: Petition of Tennessee Gas Pipeline Company requesting authority from the Department of Public Utilities to take by eminent domain under G.L. c. 79 and c. 164, such rights-of-way, easements or such other interests in land or other property necessary for the construction, operation, maintenance, alteration, or removal of natural gas transmission pipeline, appliances, appurtenances, and other equipment situated in the Towns of Hampden and East Longmeadow in the County of Hampden.
